activities.title: How this programme works
activities.body:
## Why preparation comes first

Write your lesson as plain text. A blank line starts a new paragraph.
Lines that follow without a blank line join the same paragraph.

> A line starting with this symbol becomes a quotation.

## A second heading

Headings start with two hash signs and a space.
